name: ZCA_SA_KINEMATICS_JOBS
description: This table stores each run of the  DBMS_DATA_MINING Training Model ESS Job Output.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: This column contains the Input Data Source Type for DBMS_DATA_MINING Training Model. Possible values can be TABLE, VIEW and RESTRESOURCE.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_NAME
columns.description: This column contains the Input Data Source Name for DBMS_DATA_MINING Training Model.

columns.name: MODEL_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: This column contains the DBMS_DATA_MINING Training Model  Type. Possible values could be CLASSIFICATION, REGRESSION and CLUSTERING.

columns.name: MODEL_NAME
columns.description: This column contains the Input DataSource Name for the DBMS_DATA_MINING Training Model.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_PK
columns.description: This column contains Primary Key Column Name of the Input Data Source for DBMS_DATA_MINING Training Model.

columns.name: TARGET_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: This column contains the Target Column of the Input DataSource  for the DBMS_DATA_MINING training model.

columns.name: KINEMATICS_JOB_ID
columns.description: This column contains the ESS Job Id for the Training Model.

columns.name: TRAINING_OUTPUT_JSON
columns.description: This column contains the DBMS_DATA_MINING API training model output.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_METADATA_JSON
columns.description: This column contains additional metadata json for the ESS Job and ML Training Model.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
